suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-5 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Require documented polycystic ovary syndrome and a separately established depressive disorder. Treat the study as population-level temporal association/risk evidence, not proof of direct individual causation. Preserve obesity and insulin resistance, infertility, hyperandrogenic symptoms, sleep disturbance, psychosocial factors, medication or treatment effects, and independent psychiatric risk factors as potential contributors.
